source.note: Corners out: the pane fills the window (Huan, 2026-11-13).
Corners in: back from filling the window.

sidebar.right.label: Show or hide the agent pane

source.note: Generic desktop monitor represents This Mac without an Apple logo.
A pane folded to its title row: a short window (Huan, 2026-11-14).
A pane filling its column: a tall window with its title bar.
Two overlapping windows: back to the split, from a folded or filled pane.
Linux window buttons, drawn by Sandhill on the right as Ubuntu puts them (Huan, 2026-11-18).
One window: maximise.
Two overlapping windows: back from maximised, as GNOME's restore.
Hand tool for panning PDF, SVG and image previews.

data.import.label: Import a dataset into a session

source.note: An arrow into a box, so Variables' Import differs from the Data Explorer's table (Huan, 2026-11-18).
A table column's menu, as Positron's data explorer has it (Huan, 2026-11-14).
Upward arrow from the current-cell boundary represents running cells above; no compound play-and-arrow artwork is added.
Downward arrow from the current-cell boundary represents running this cell and below; distinct from the upward Run all above glyph.
Generic eraser represents clearing notebook outputs.
Pause bars represent interrupting execution; Stop uses the distinct square glyph.
Stacked contexts represent the collection of sessions rather than a specific terminal instance.
Generic commit graph represents Git controls, not the Git brand logo.
Archive box represents stashing working changes; no Git-specific stash artwork is available.
Downward transfer to a boundary represents pulling changes.
Upward transfer to a boundary represents pushing changes.
Generic robot represents an agent without implying any AI vendor identity.
